metadata.method: Experimental archive sample covering all 66 eligible audited bundles. Tournament is the deduplicated union of the frozen Venue and conservative Tournament draws, each selecting up to 100 singles games per bundle by hash. Each game/player side enters Tournament once even if selected by both draws. This includes eligible event-venue recordings without set-level proof. Pro Tournament includes all evidence-mapped player sides in those bundles' conservative tournament games. Per-bundle sampling caps and archive coverage can bias estimates; counts pool opportunities, not players. Tournament and Pro Tournament may overlap and are not skill ranks. All dates; exact character, opponent and stage filters.
